prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot viewed from inside a dark guest bedroom looking out through an open doorway into a brightly lit hallway. Centered in the doorway stands a tall female silhouette in full black against the bright hallway ceiling light behind her. Silhouette shape: long straight black hair tied in a low ponytail, slim petite build, fitted long-sleeve top tucked into high-waisted leggings, fluffy-cuff house slippers. One arm raised to chest height holding a thin toothbrush shape. Face details entirely obscured by the backlight silhouette treatment. A short shadow of the slippers falls on the hallway floor. A thin blade of cold white morning light cuts through the bedroom curtain seam on the right side of the frame. Cool blue-grey bedroom interior, warm white hallway light. Documentarian mood, doorway-as-threshold tension. Text watermark 'P01-PN03' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: any visible face details on the silhouette, anime proportions, bright daylight bedroom, decorative hallway art, smiling figure, approaching figure (she is stationary), any second character in frame
